european gas prices fall below 50 euros.title: European gas prices end 2023 near 32 euros per megawatt hour
european gas prices fall below 50 euros.snippet: Dutch TTF front-month gas settled around 32 euros per megawatt hour in December, confirmed by exchange data, well below the 50 euro level analysts had watched.

knowledge workers never return physical.snippet: Surveys show roughly 12 percent of knowledge workers are fully remote in 2024. Predictions that most would never return to an office failed to materialize.
